      ],
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# TASK 2 - DEEP LEARNING IMAGE CLASSIFICATION\n",
        "# Using PyTorch and Transfer Learning\n",
        "\n",
        "# Import libraries\n",
        "import torch\n",
        "import torchvision\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "from torchvision import datasets, transforms, models\n",
        "from torch import nn, optim\n",
        "from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Libraries imported successfully!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check device\n",
        "device = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Device:\", device)\n",
        "print(\"PyTorch version:\", torch.__version__)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 3: Dataset Loading and Data Augmentation\n",
        "\n",
        "train_transform = transforms.Compose([\n",
        "    transforms.RandomCrop(32, padding=4),\n",
        "    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),\n",
        "    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),\n",
        "    transforms.ToTensor(),\n",
        "    transforms.Normalize(\n",
        "        mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406],\n",
        "        std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "test_transform = transforms.Compose([\n",
        "    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),\n",
        "    transforms.ToTensor(),\n",
        "    transforms.Normalize(\n",
        "        mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406],\n",
        "        std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "train_dataset = datasets.CIFAR10(\n",
        "    root=\"./data\",\n",
        "    train=True,\n",
        "    download=True,\n",
        "    transform=train_transform\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_dataset = datasets.CIFAR10(\n",
        "    root=\"./data\",\n",
        "    train=False,\n",
        "    download=True,\n",
        "    transform=test_transform\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "train_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    train_dataset,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=True,\n",
        "    num_workers=2\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    test_dataset,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=False,\n",
        "    num_workers=2\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training samples:\", len(train_dataset))\n",
        "print(\"Testing samples:\", len(test_dataset))\n",
        "print(\"Dataset loaded successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "OnGPHq10aWm8",
        "outputId": "e7423802-0131-4037-dd9e-1e366624c8b3"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",

          "text": [
            "100%|██████████| 170M/170M [26:41<00:00, 106kB/s]\n"
          ]
        },
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training samples: 50000\n",
            "Testing samples: 10000\n",
            "Dataset loaded successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 4: Create a Smaller Dataset for Faster Training\n",
        "\n",
        "from torch.utils.data import Subset\n",
        "\n",
        "generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "train_indices = torch.randperm(\n",
        "    len(train_dataset),\n",
        "    generator=generator\n",
        ")[:10000].tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "test_indices = torch.randperm(\n",
        "    len(test_dataset),\n",
        "    generator=generator\n",
        ")[:2000].tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "train_subset = Subset(train_dataset, train_indices)\n",
        "test_subset = Subset(test_dataset, test_indices)\n",
        "\n",
        "train_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    train_subset,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=True,\n",
        "    num_workers=2\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    test_subset,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=False,\n",
        "    num_workers=2\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training subset:\", len(train_subset))\n",
        "print(\"Testing subset:\", len(test_subset))\n",
        "print(\"Subset created successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "6K-ii7NBg_2W",
        "outputId": "74d68361-5f5d-495c-8403-0917b43a2da3"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training subset: 10000\n",
            "Testing subset: 2000\n",
            "Subset created successfully!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 5: Load Pretrained ResNet18 Model\n",
        "\n",
        "weights = models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT\n",
        "\n",
        "model = models.resnet18(weights=weights)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Freeze pretrained layers\n",
        "for parameter in model.parameters():\n",
        "    parameter.requires_grad = False\n",
        "\n",
        "# Replace the final classification layer\n",
        "model.fc = nn.Linear(\n",
        "    model.fc.in_features,\n",
        "    10\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Move model to GPU or CPU\n",
        "model = model.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Pretrained ResNet18 loaded successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Model is running on:\", device)\n",
        "print(\"Output classes: 10\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "fgyf7a7nheDR",

      },
      "execution_count": null,

          ]

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 6: Model Training\n",
        "\n",
        "criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
        "\n",
        "optimizer = optim.Adam(\n",
        "    model.fc.parameters(),\n",
        "    lr=0.001\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "num_epochs = 3\n",
        "\n",
        "train_losses = []\n",
        "train_accuracies = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for epoch in range(num_epochs):\n",
        "\n",
        "    model.train()\n",
        "\n",
        "    running_loss = 0.0\n",
        "    correct = 0\n",
        "    total = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    for images, labels in train_loader:\n",
        "\n",
        "        images = images.to(device)\n",
        "        labels = labels.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "        optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
        "\n",
        "        outputs = model(images)\n",
        "\n",
        "        loss = criterion(outputs, labels)\n",
        "\n",
        "        loss.backward()\n",
        "        optimizer.step()\n",
        "\n",
        "        running_loss += loss.item() * images.size(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "        _, predicted = torch.max(outputs, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        total += labels.size(0)\n",
        "        correct += (predicted == labels).sum().item()\n",
        "\n",
        "    epoch_loss = running_loss / total\n",
        "    epoch_accuracy = correct / total\n",
        "\n",
        "    train_losses.append(epoch_loss)\n",
        "    train_accuracies.append(epoch_accuracy)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        f\"Epoch [{epoch+1}/{num_epochs}] \"\n",
        "        f\"Loss: {epoch_loss:.4f} \"\n",
        "        f\"Accuracy: {epoch_accuracy:.4f}\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training completed successfully!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {

        "# Step 7: Plot Training Curves\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))\n",

        "# Training Loss\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 8: Model Evaluation\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
        "    accuracy_score,\n",
        "    classification_report,\n",
        "    confusion_matrix\n",
        ")\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "classes = [\n",
        "    \"airplane\", \"automobile\", \"bird\", \"cat\", \"deer\",\n",
        "    \"dog\", \"frog\", \"horse\", \"ship\", \"truck\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "model.eval()\n",
        "\n",
        "all_predictions = []\n",
        "all_labels = []\n",
        "\n",
        "with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "\n",
        "    for images, labels in test_loader:\n",
        "\n",
        "        images = images.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "        outputs = model(images)\n",
        "\n",
        "        predictions = torch.argmax(outputs, dim=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        all_predictions.extend(predictions.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "        all_labels.extend(labels.numpy())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Test Accuracy\n",
        "test_accuracy = accuracy_score(\n",
        "    all_labels,\n",
        "    all_predictions\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Test Accuracy: {test_accuracy:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Test Accuracy: {test_accuracy * 100:.2f}%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Classification Report\n",
        "print(\"\\nClassification Report:\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    classification_report(\n",
        "        all_labels,\n",
        "        all_predictions,\n",
        "        target_names=classes,\n",
        "        zero_division=0\n",
        "    )\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Confusion Matrix\n",
        "cm = confusion_matrix(\n",
        "    all_labels,\n",
        "    all_predictions\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    cm,\n",
        "    annot=True,\n",
        "    fmt=\"d\",\n",
        "    cmap=\"Blues\",\n",
        "    xticklabels=classes,\n",
        "    yticklabels=classes\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Confusion Matrix - ResNet18\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Predicted Label\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"True Label\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.yticks(rotation=0)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 10: Model Inference\n",
        "\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Get one batch of test images\n",
        "images, labels = next(iter(test_loader))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select one image\n",
        "image = images[0].to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Prediction\n",
        "model.eval()\n",
        "\n",
        "with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "    output = model(image.unsqueeze(0))\n",
        "    predicted_class = torch.argmax(output, dim=1).item()\n",
        "\n",
        "actual_class = labels[0].item()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Predicted Class:\", classes[predicted_class])\n",
        "print(\"Actual Class:\", classes[actual_class])"

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Step 11: Display Prediction\n",
        "\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Get one test image\n",
        "images, labels = next(iter(test_loader))\n",
        "\n",
        "image = images[0].to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "model.eval()\n",
        "\n",
        "with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "    output = model(image.unsqueeze(0))\n",
        "    predicted_class = torch.argmax(output, dim=1).item()\n",
        "\n",
        "actual_class = labels[0].item()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert normalized image for display\n",
        "display_image = images[0].permute(1, 2, 0).numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "mean = np.array([0.485, 0.456, 0.406])\n",
        "std = np.array([0.229, 0.224, 0.225])\n",
        "\n",
        "display_image = display_image * std + mean\n",
        "display_image = np.clip(display_image, 0, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))\n",
        "plt.imshow(display_image)\n",
        "plt.title(\n",
        "    f\"Predicted: {classes[predicted_class]}\\n\"\n",
        "    f\"Actual: {classes[actual_class]}\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Prediction completed successfully!\")"
      ],
